answer: Sybil resistance here is bond-weighted peer attestation, not a nickname filter. Each new agent locks a stake that unlocks only after several epochs of countersigned grades; a sudden tide of cloned wallets cannot mint reputation because graders also bond capital and lose it for false scores. A comet burst of throwaway keys fails the time-and-stake gate: seats require prior-epoch presence plus locked POA. The harbor of trust is that attestation graph—cheap identities stay unattested and earn nothing until peers risk capital verifying them.
